Country: United Kingdom
Partner: Manchester Money
Category: Banking Services
Overview: Manchester Money is an award-winning mortgage broker based in the UK that helps
individuals, including expats and self-employed clients, find the most suitable mortgage
products from a range of lenders. They work by connecting clients with specialist
brokers who search the "whole-of-market" for deals, assess affordability, and manage
the mortgage application process, providing personalized advice and support remotely.
The service aims to save clients time and stress by handling the paperwork and finding
exclusive deals they might not find on their own.
Why we recommend: Manchester Money is a trusted provider of financial services in the UK, offering convenient solutions for money transfers, currency exchange, and international payments. They are known for competitive rates and reliable service, making them a go-to option for newcomers and expatriates.
How it helps: Manchester Money helps you move your money safely and efficiently, whether you’re sending funds to family, paying bills abroad, or managing your finances across borders. Their straightforward platform and expert support make handling your finances in a new country simple and stress-free.
Link: https://www.manchester-money.co.uk/smooth-migration/

Country: United Kingdom
Partner: Airalo e-SIM
Category: Data and Phone Plans
Overview: Airalo is the world’s first and largest eSIM marketplace, providing digital SIM (eSIM)
plans for travelers to access mobile data, and sometimes calls and texts, in over 200
countries and regions without needing a physical SIM card. To use Airalo, you download
the app, purchase a digital eSIM for your destination, install it on your compatible
device, and then connect to a mobile network upon arrival to get online.
Why we recommend: We recommend Airalo for its affordability, reliability, and convenience—offering seamless data access wherever you go. With Airalo’s eSIM technology, you can skip the hassle of physical SIM cards and avoid high roaming charges when traveling or moving abroad. Their plans are flexible and cover a wide range of destinations, making it easy to stay connected no matter where life takes you. Airalo is a trusted choice for newcomers and frequent travelers who want cost-effective and stress-free mobile data solutions.
How it helps: Airalo makes migration and travel easier by giving you instant, hassle-free mobile connectivity the moment you arrive in your new country. With their eSIM technology, you can skip the need for local SIM cards and avoid costly roaming charges, saving both time and money. Their wide range of global plans ensures you stay connected wherever you go, whether for work, family, or exploring your new surroundings. By providing reliable data access from day one, Airalo helps you settle in smoothly and stay connected without stress.
Link: https://airalo.pxf.io/7m4YGA

Country: United Kingdom
Partner: Tesco Mobile (hold pending updated contract)
Category: Data and Phone Plans
Overview: Tesco Mobile is a mobile virtual network operator (MVNO) that provides mobile phone
services, including calls, texts, and data, by using another network's infrastructure, such
as O2 in the UK or the Three network in Ireland. It functions by leveraging the existing
network of its partner operator to deliver its services, allowing it to offer various plans
and benefits, like Clubcard points, to its customers.
Why we recommend: Tesco Mobile is a well-known mobile network provider in the UK, offering reliable coverage, flexible plans, and excellent customer support. They’re a popular choice for newcomers who want an affordable and hassle-free mobile service.
How it helps: Tesco Mobile makes it easy to stay connected from day one, whether you need a pay-as-you-go plan or a monthly contract. Their simple setup, wide network coverage, and flexible options help you manage your communication needs without stress.
Link: https://tescomobile.pxf.io/3Pv9jv

Country: United Kingdom
Partner: Starling Bank
Category: Banking Services
Overview: Starling Bank is a UK-based, fully digital bank offering personal, joint, business, and
teen accounts, along with a euro account and prepaid cards, all managed via a mobile
app. It operates without physical branches and functions by providing online banking
services, allowing users to manage their accounts, conduct transactions, and access
features like spending insights and international payments directly through their
smartphone. Just Travel cover
Why we recommend: Starling Bank is a modern, digital-first UK bank known for its intuitive app, no hidden fees, and excellent customer support. It’s highly recommended for newcomers who want a simple and efficient way to manage their finances.
How it helps: Starling Bank allows you to open an account quickly from anywhere, track your spending, and make international payments with ease. Their tools and features make banking straightforward, helping you stay in control of your money while settling into a new country.
Link: http://starling-bank.nny66p.net/c/3565886/1436123/10945

Country: United Kingdom
Partner: Rentguarantor
Category: Insurance
Overview: RentGuarantor.com is a UK-based company that acts as a professional rent guarantor
for tenants who cannot provide a traditional individual guarantor. The company charges
a fee and, in return, provides a financially secure, insurance-backed promise to the
landlord that the rent will be paid, even if the tenant is unable to. This service is
available to a wide range of tenants, including students, employed individuals, and
those receiving benefits, who might otherwise struggle to secure a rental property.
Why we recommend: Rentguarantor is a trusted UK service that helps renters secure tenancy agreements by acting as a guarantor when you don’t have a local one. They make it easier for newcomers and young professionals to access rental properties without unnecessary hurdles.
How it helps: By providing a reliable guarantor, Rentguarantor ensures landlords feel confident renting to you, even if you don’t have an established credit history in the UK. This service simplifies the rental process, giving you faster access to your new home and peace of mind during your move.
Link: https://rentguarantor.com/?ref=mjiwzgq

Country: United Kingdom
Partner: Pet Protect
Category: Insurance
Overview: Pet Protect UK is a pet insurance provider that has been offering lifetime and max
benefit cover for cats, dogs, and rabbits in the UK for over 40 years. It provides financial
protection for expensive vet fees due to accidents and illnesses. The policies work by
you paying a monthly premium, and Pet Protect covering eligible vet costs up to a
specified annual limit after you pay an excess and the policy's vet fee contribution.
Why we recommend: Pet Protect UK is a leading provider of pet insurance, offering flexible and comprehensive coverage for dogs, cats, and other pets. They are trusted for their transparent policies and responsive customer service, making them a reliable choice for pet owners.
How it helps: Pet Protect UK helps you manage unexpected veterinary costs, ensuring your pet receives the care they need without causing financial stress. Their plans cover everything from routine check-ups to emergencies, keeping your furry family members healthy and happy as you settle into your new home.
Link: http://www.petprotect.co.uk/?utm_source=Smooth

Country: United Kingdom
Partner: Bond Vehicle Leasing
Category: Vehicle Services
Overview: At Bond Vehicle Leasing we are committed to finding you the perfect car or van that
meet your needs as well as your budget. We offer unbeatable deals on all makes and
models of cars and vans with a variety of finance options for both business and
personal users. We can source our vehicles from a network of automotive providers and
funders nationwide, to get you the best deal every time!
We make Vehicle Leasing easy… Included in your lease will be:
• Free Road Tax.
• Full Manufacturer’s Warranty.
• Free Breakdown Cover.
• Your new Car/Van delivered to your doorstep.
Why we recommend: Bond Vehicle Leasing is a trusted UK provider of vehicle leasing solutions, offering flexible plans for both individuals and businesses. They are known for competitive rates, excellent customer support, and a wide range of vehicles to suit different needs.
How it helps: Bond Vehicle Leasing helps newcomers and residents secure reliable transportation without the high upfront costs of purchasing a car. Their flexible leasing options cater to both short- and long-term needs, making it easy to find a plan that fits your lifestyle and budget. With a straightforward application and delivery process, they remove the usual stress associated with getting a vehicle. By providing convenient and dependable transportation, Bond Vehicle Leasing allows you to focus on settling into your new home and managing daily life with ease.
Link: https://www.bondleasing.co.uk/contact-us/

Country: United Kingdom
Partner: ExpatRide
Category: Vehicle Services
Overview: ExpatRide provides specialized global car services, such as rentals and leases, for
expatriates moving to new countries, offering a streamlined experience by handling the
complexities of local credit, licensing, and billing for their corporate clients and
Relocation Management Companies (RMCs). They offer personalized solutions,
including professional chauffeur services and airport transfers, to support expatriates'
transportation needs worldwide, functioning as a global mobility partner.
Why we recommend: ExpatRide specializes in helping expats with reliable, tailored car solutions worldwide. They understand the unique challenges of relocating and provide services designed to make transportation simple from the moment you arrive. Whether you need a short-term rental, a long-term lease, or chauffeur services, ExpatRide offers flexible options to match your lifestyle. With their global reach and focus on expat needs, they make getting around in a new country stress-free and convenient.
How it helps: ExpatRide helps newcomers access reliable transportation quickly and conveniently, making settling into a new country much easier. They offer a range of tailored vehicle solutions, including short- and long-term rentals, leases, and chauffeur services, to suit different lifestyles and needs. Their global network and personalized approach ensure you get a vehicle that fits your requirements without unnecessary stress. By simplifying transportation, ExpatRide allows you to focus on your move and daily life with confidence and freedom.
Link: https://www.expatride.com/smooth-migration/

Country: United Kingdom
Partner: Wise
Category: Banking Services
Overview: Wise (formerly TransferWise) is a financial technology company that
provides online money transfer services and a multi-currency account for
individuals and businesses to send, spend, and receive money
internationally at low fees and the mid-market exchange rate. Key features
include high-speed, low-fee international transfers, a debit card for
spending in different currencies, and the ability to hold balances in over 40
currencies.
Why we recommend: We recommend Wise for its transparency, speed, and cost-effectiveness compared to traditional banks. With clear, upfront fees and real exchange rates, Wise ensures you always know exactly what you’re paying for, without hidden charges. Their platform is designed for fast and secure international transfers, making it easier to move money across borders. Whether you’re sending funds to family, paying for services, or managing finances in multiple countries, Wise offers a simple and affordable solution you can trust.
How it helps: Wise helps newcomers move money internationally with ease, making it simpler to manage expenses and support family abroad during relocation. Their platform offers fast and secure transfers at low, transparent fees, ensuring you get the best value for your money. With real exchange rates and no hidden charges, Wise removes the uncertainty often associated with international banking. This makes managing finances across countries straightforward, allowing you to focus on settling into your new home with confidence.
Link: https://wise.prf.hn/click/camref:1011lq4nL

Country: United Kingdom
Partner: Remitly
Category: Banking Services
Overview: Remitly is a digital remittance service that enables users to send money internationally
quickly, affordably, and securely, primarily, to family and friends. To use it, you create an
account on the Remitly website or mobile app, enter the recipient's details and desired
amount, select a delivery option like bank deposit, cash pickup, or mobile money, and
pay for the transfer. Remitly guarantees on-time delivery or refunds your fees and uses
multiple security layers to protect transfers.
Why we recommend: We recommend Remitly for its fast transfers, multiple payout options, and reliable customer support. With Remitly, you can choose how your money is delivered—whether it’s direct to a bank account, as a cash pickup, or even delivered to a mobile wallet. Their secure platform ensures peace of mind, while competitive rates and speed make sending money abroad both affordable and convenient. For newcomers supporting family overseas, Remitly offers a trusted and flexible way to stay connected financially.
How it helps: Remitly helps newcomers easily send money to family or manage finances across borders, reducing stress during relocation. Their platform offers multiple delivery options, including bank deposits, cash pickups, and mobile wallets, providing flexibility to suit different needs. Transfers are fast, secure, and reliable, giving you peace of mind that your money will reach its destination safely. By simplifying international payments, Remitly allows you to focus on settling into your new country while staying connected financially with loved ones.
Link: https://remitly.tod8mp.net/Jr6DAv

Country: United Kingdom
Partner: XE
Category: Banking Services
Overview: Xe (xe.com) is a company that provides online currency conversion tools and
international money transfer services. You can use their website and app to convert
currencies at market rates, view historical charts and set rate alerts, and send money
directly to bank accounts or for cash pickup in other countries. To send money, you
register for an account, provide details of the recipient, confirm the payment amount,
choose a payment method (like a bank transfer or card), and process the transaction.
Why we recommend: We recommend XE for its reliability, transparent fees, and real-time currency tracking. Known worldwide as a trusted currency exchange and transfer service, XE makes moving money across borders simple and stress-free. Their platform provides live exchange rates, helping you make informed decisions and get the best value when sending or receiving funds. With secure transfers and a reputation for accuracy, XE is an excellent choice for newcomers managing international finances.
How it helps: XE helps newcomers manage cross-border finances efficiently, making it easier to pay bills, receive funds, or transfer money internationally. Their platform provides real-time exchange rates and transparent fees, ensuring you always know the true value of your transactions. With secure, reliable transfers, XE removes the stress and uncertainty often associated with moving money between countries. This allows newcomers to focus on settling into their new home while confidently handling their financial needs abroad.
Link: https://xe-money-transfer.sjv.io/9WNvNe

Country: United Kingdom
Partner: Sirelo (Experts in Moving)
Category: International Moving
Overview: Sirelo is an independent online platform for the moving industry that helps people find
and compare removal companies by providing customer reviews and free quotes for
international and national moves. Users can post their experiences with moving
companies to create a comprehensive database of reviews and can request up to five
free quotes from movers in their area. Sirelo's goal is to make the moving process more
transparent for consumers.
Why we recommend: We recommend Experts in Moving for their experience, reliable service, and personalized approach to international relocations. With years of expertise, they understand the complexities of moving abroad and are committed to making the process as smooth as possible. Their tailored solutions cover every detail—from packing and shipping to customs clearance—ensuring your belongings arrive safely. By combining professionalism with a personal touch, Experts in Moving helps take the stress out of your relocation journey.
How it helps: Experts in Moving helps newcomers transport their belongings safely and efficiently, reducing stress during the moving process. Their experienced team handles every step, from packing and loading to customs clearance and delivery, ensuring your items arrive intact and on time. With personalized solutions tailored to your specific relocation needs, they make even complex international moves manageable. By taking care of the logistics, Experts in Moving allows you to focus on settling into your new home with peace of mind.
Link: https://www.expertsinmoving.com/?so=a&ca=8ddabfceef8192200632f66a00293f9c

Country: United Kingdom
Partner: 1st Formations
Category: Business Registration - New Category?
Overview: 1st Formations is a UK-based online company that helps individuals and businesses
register different types of companies and offers additional services like providing a
registered office and mail handling. It works by processing the company formation with
the UK's Companies House, allowing customers to choose from various packages,
including those for companies limited by shares, companies limited by guarantee, and
limited liability partnerships. The service simplifies the registration process, enabling
new companies to be formed quickly and efficiently by experts.
Why we recommend: 1st Formations is a leading UK company formation service, trusted for helping entrepreneurs and newcomers register businesses quickly and efficiently. They are known for their reliable support, clear guidance, and fast processing times. With a focus on simplicity and accuracy, 1st Formations handles all the paperwork and legal requirements, so you don’t have to navigate complex processes alone. Their expertise ensures that your business is set up correctly from the start, giving you confidence and a strong foundation to grow.
How it helps: 1st Formations simplifies the process of setting up a company in the UK, handling paperwork, registration, and compliance so you don’t have to navigate it alone. This allows you to start your business with confidence and focus on growth rather than administrative hurdles.
Link: https://1st-formations-limited.sjv.io/VxZ9DJ

Country: United Kingdom
Partner: Just Travel Cover
Category: Insurance
Overview: Just Travel Cover is a trusted insurance provider that makes travel safer and stress-free by offering tailored policies for every type of traveller. Whether you’re moving abroad, taking a holiday, or visiting family, they provide coverage that protects you from unexpected costs like medical emergencies, cancellations, or lost belongings. Their flexible plans are designed to suit different needs, including families, seniors, and those with pre-existing medical conditions. With Just Travel Cover, you can focus on your journey knowing you’re supported every step of the way.
Why we recommend: Just Travel Cover is a well-established insurance provider specializing in travel insurance tailored to different needs, including families, seniors, and those with pre-existing conditions. They are known for their comprehensive policies and excellent customer care.
How it helps: With Just Travel Cover, you can travel with peace of mind knowing you’re protected against unexpected costs like medical emergencies, cancellations, or lost baggage. Their flexible plans ensure you get the right level of coverage for your journey, making your move or travels worry-free.
Link: https://just-travel-cover.pxf.io/WD5x1n
